title: LIST OF GALLANTRY AWARDS TO INDIAN NAVAL PERSONNEL ON THE EVE OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
body_text:
President Smt. Droupadi Murmu , has approved following Gallantry awards to Indian Navy personnel on the eve of Independence Day 2026.
SHAURYA CHAKRA
1.      LT CDR SHIVAM KUMAR
NAO SENA MEDAL (GALLANTARY)
1.      CDR YUVRAJ KUMAR
2.      CDR VINEET SHARMA
3.      C AVINASH ANNASO, POA (FD)
MENTION-IN-DESPATCHES
1.      CDR NIKHIL CHUGH
2.      LT AJAY JOSE N JOSEPH
3.      ABHISHEK DHANAWADE, SEA I (CD)
4.      ASHWIN SANTHOSH, AVR SEA (CD)
*****
VM/ A S

enrichment.summary: On the eve of Independence Day 2026, President Droupadi Murmu approved gallantry awards for Indian Naval personnel, including one Shaurya Chakra to Lt Cdr Shivam Kumar, three Nao Sena Medals (Gallantry), and four Mention-in-Despatches. The release lists the names and ranks of all awardees.
enrichment.context: Gallantry awards such as the Shaurya Chakra (a peacetime gallantry award ranking below the Ashoka Chakra and Kirti Chakra) and the Nao Sena Medal (Gallantry) are announced twice a year, on Republic Day and Independence Day, recognising acts of courage by defence personnel. Mention-in-Despatches is a lesser distinction denoting gallant or meritorious action mentioned in official dispatches. These announcements are a routine part of India's honours system administered by the Ministry of Defence and the President's Secretariat, and typically do not disclose operational details of the actions being honoured.
